findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/review-prior.js::review-prior may list a different round than a resumed dialogue loop continues
findings.title: review-prior may list a different round than a resumed dialogue loop continues
findings.action: Detect a mismatch between the stashed next_round and the round files on disk
findings.refutation: review-prior and resolveRoundChain both read the round files on disk in numeric order, so the round the reviewer is shown is always the round its handles resolve against, whatever next_round says.
findings.disposition_rationale: A lost round file shifts both readers identically; a handle cannot point at a round other than the one listed.

occurrences.title: review-prior may list a different round than a resumed dialogue loop continues
